hypothesis: The exact-C model is limited by variance and unstable fine numeric splits rather than missing local calibration. Keeping approximately the same total learning-rate budget while increasing L2 shrinkage and reducing numeric borders may improve one-season-ahead transfer across both R and full routes.

novelty_and_prior_disclosure.exact_C_prior: The current exact-C parent uses 500 trees, learning_rate 0.05, L2 12, and default border count. The prior three-seed experiment held those settings fixed and did not test this regularization regime.
novelty_and_prior_disclosure.method_only_inspiration: The broad low-learning-rate, strong-L2, low-border CatBoost pattern was observed in a public competition repository, but no external data, fitted model, predictions, labels, or leaderboard-derived target information is used.

selection_order: maximize minimum full-score gain across 2020 and 2021
maximize minimum R-score gain across 2020 and 2021

source_protocol.on_fail: Close this fixed regularization family without reading 2022+ candidate labels.
source_protocol.on_pass: Freeze gamma and run untouched 2022/2023 development validation.
